name: TOTP Recovery Code Sign-In Success
summary: A returning user with an outstanding TOTP MFA requirement chooses recovery-code authentication, submits one valid unused recovery code, consumes that code exactly once, and establishes an authenticated application session.
finalOutcome: One valid TOTP recovery code is consumed for the existing durable identity and the outstanding MFA requirement is satisfied by an authenticated application session.

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync already provides the one-time recovery-code validation and consumption primitive.
Current recovery-code consumption is confirmed-current-user only, so the sign-in/session orchestration boundary remains implementation work.
Canonical recovery-code entry surface is now defined; React Native has a presentation shell while Angular and functional verification remain outstanding.
Recovery code is modeled as an alternate way to satisfy the TOTP MFA requirement, not as a standalone primary login credential.
